Day 2 - Helsinki & Tallinn - 16th of September
Day Excursion to Tallinn
Today brings a memorable cross-border experience, with a guided excursion from Helsinki to Tallinn. After travelling across the Baltic Sea, enjoy a guided walk through Tallinn’s atmospheric Old Town before returning to Helsinki in the evening.
Full-Day Experience
Excursion to Tallinn - Guided Experience

Departure from Tallinn: 7:30 PM

Old Town Guided Tour
Time: 1:00 PM - 3:30 PM
Meeting point: Under the Town Hall clock
Notable Sights
St Nicholas Church
Freedom Square
Alexander Nevsky Cathedral
St Mary’s Cathedral
Danish King’s Garden
Additional Old Town highlights along the route

Guided tour
English-speaking guide
Local recommendations
Description
Explore Tallinn’s historic Old Town with a guide, discovering cobbled streets, medieval architecture, church towers, squares and viewpoints that bring the city’s layered history to life.
Your Free Time
After returning to Helsinki, enjoy the evening at leisure.

Day 5 - Stockholm - 19th of September
Private Guided Tour of the Vasa Museum
Today includes a private guided visit to the Vasa Museum, one of Stockholm’s most remarkable cultural highlights. The museum is home to the preserved 17th-century warship Vasa, offering a fascinating look into Swedish maritime history.
Morning Experience
Private Guided Tour of Vasa Museum
Time: Morning
Meeting point: Hotel pick-up
Included With This Experience
Transfers to and from the museum
Guide
Tickets
Description
Discover the story of the Vasa, the richly decorated warship that sank on its maiden voyage and was later recovered in extraordinary condition. Your guided visit provides context, history and insight into one of Sweden’s most famous museum experiences.
Your Free Time
Enjoy the rest of the day at leisure in Stockholm.

Day 11 - Bergen - 25th of September
Private Bergen City Drive
Today includes a private guided city drive, giving you a comfortable introduction to Bergen’s history, neighbourhoods, viewpoints and coastal character.
Morning Experience
Private Bergen City Drive
Time: 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM
Meeting point: Hotel pick-up
Included With This Experience
All transport modes, including fuel and tolls
A bottle of water for each guest
Well-travelled, well-informed guide
Highlights
Bergen’s historical core by the colourful medieval wharf
The charming peninsula that defines the city’s development
The marina where iconic boats share their stories
Winding roads halfway to Mt Fløyen for a bird’s-eye view
One of the city’s most affluent neighbourhoods
A fairytale church with a Viking twist
A slice of royalty in the city’s most popular picnic spot
The earliest Bergen and the city’s historic origins
A cascading waterfall and birdsong on the fringe of the city
The largest lake in the Bergen peninsula
Description
Enjoy a guided drive through Bergen, combining the city’s historic core with scenic viewpoints, coastal neighbourhoods and stories that connect the city’s past and present.
Your Free Time
Enjoy the rest of the day at leisure in Bergen.

Day 13 - Tromsø - 27th of September
Arctic Fjords and Northern Lights
Today combines dramatic Arctic scenery with an evening Northern Lights chase. During the day, explore the landscapes outside Tromsø, before heading out again in the evening in search of the aurora.
Daytime Experience
Arctic Fjord Explorer, Mountains, Coast & Hidden Beaches
Time: 10:15 AM - 3:45 PM
Included With This Experience
Norwegian chocolate, Kvikk Lunsj
Norwegian soda, Solo
Guide
Description
Explore the stunning Arctic landscape just outside Tromsø on a scenic fjord adventure, with mountains, coastline and hidden beaches shaping the day’s route.
Your Free Time
Enjoy some time at leisure before the evening experience.
Evening Experience
Private Northern Lights Chase by Minibus
Time: 8:00 PM - 2:00 AM
Meeting point: Hotel pick-up
Included With This Experience
Pick-up/drop-off in central Tromsø
Professional guide and photographer
Free professional photos after the tour
Thermal suits to keep warm
Cosy bonfire if the weather allows
Water, coffee, tea and hot chocolate
Small tasty snack for everyone
Description
Head out from Tromsø by minibus in search of the Northern Lights. With a professional guide and photographer, the evening is designed around finding the best possible conditions and creating a comfortable Arctic experience.

Important travel notes
Transport schedules, including flights, trains, buses, ferries and cruises, are subject to operational changes. Final confirmed timings will be provided in the travel vouchers.
Activities may be weather dependent and can be adjusted if required for safety, availability or operational reasons.
Northern Lights sightings are a natural phenomenon and cannot be guaranteed. The tours are arranged to give the best possible opportunity based on local conditions.
Hotel check-in and check-out times vary by property. As a general guideline, check-in in the Nordic region is usually between 3:00 PM and 4:30 PM, while check-out is usually between 10:00 AM and 12:00 noon.
Cruise cabin categories and onboard inclusions are based on the details listed in the itinerary. Final cabin numbers and boarding information will be provided in the travel vouchers.
Additional nights can be added on request where the itinerary allows.
Additional private transfers for city exploration days, railway stations, bus terminals, airports or cruise ports can be arranged as optional add-ons if needed.
Additional activities, excursions or longer-duration experiences can also be suggested and arranged on request at an additional cost.
